import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(P)
    e=np.exp(-t); q=1/(1+t)
    s=np.sin(p[9]*t); c=np.cos(p[9]*t)
    return (p[0]*e+p[1]*P*e+p[2]*L*e+p[3]*P*L*e+p[4]*P+p[5]*P*q+p[6]*P*L*q+p[7]*q+p[8]*P*c+0*s)
